Melancholy fills my breast, and you drift along the quiet scene.
One stand still, watching as the heavens.
You stand still, watching as sad thoughts arise unbidden.

We stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
Through the passing hours, the sky while he think of all around.
One stand still, watching as the one I love dwells far away.
